_readme: Config for tools/check_review_signature.py (board card #668).
READ FROM THE BASE REF, never from the PR's checkout — a PR must not be able to
widen the allowlist it is checked against.
shared_credentials: gh logins that MORE THAN ONE CELL can push reviews through.
An approval from one of these does not name its author, so it must carry a
'Reviewed-by: <cell>' trailer. Measured 2026-09-02: reviewers-pixel was 72% of
mesh-gateway reviews and 79% of swarph-cli's, and the sys3 box alone holds four
gh logins including it.
cells: the mesh roster a trailer may name. Derived from peers active in the mesh
log since 2026-08-01. Add a cell here when it starts reviewing.
NOT EVERY NAME HERE IS A MESH PEER. `grok-bot` is the commander's GitHub
review bot: it reviews a PR after 30 minutes of inactivity and is the reviewer
of last resort when the Claude cells are cap-bound — which is why it is being
made attributable rather than removed. It posts through reviewers-pixel like a
cell does, so the trailer is the only thing that can name it. Measured
2026-09-02: of the four PRs opened that morning, #147 was the ONLY one to sit
past thirty minutes and the ONLY one to carry an unsigned approval.
This list is therefore a roster of REVIEWING ACTORS, not of peers.
THE TWO LISTS ARE DIFFERENT NAMESPACES AND A STRING MAY BE IN BOTH.
cells              = a name a trailer MAY CLAIM
shared_credentials = a gh login that MUST CARRY one
'lab-ovh' is both: a cell name AND the ACTIVE gh login in a hosts.yml that ten
cells on this box share (all run as ubuntu with HOME=/home/ubuntu). Listing it
only under 'cells' felt complete and left the gate open: another cell could push
as reviewers-pixel and approve as lab-ovh, passing require_last_push_approval on
different logins and needing no trailer. science-claude measured it 2026-09-02.
Membership in BOTH lists is correct and must never be treated as a conflict.
PORTED TO swarph-cli 2026-09-11 on board card #831. This repo already requires
1 approval + require_last_push_approval (measured 2026-09-11), which closes the
LOGIN half; an unsigned shared-credential approval still satisfies that
requirement while naming no ACTOR — the half this gate closes. Lists are
unchanged from mesh-gateway/lab-orchestrator: same shared logins, same reviewing
roster, same box.
